tools.name: list_sites
tools.description: List the websites on this DevDome account with their verification status.

tools.name: add_site
tools.description: Add a website to the account. Returns the tracking snippet to install; the site stays pending until verified.

tools.name: verify_site
tools.description: Verify ownership of a pending website (checks the installed snippet or DNS TXT record).

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Headline KPIs for a site: visits, visitors, pageviews, outbound clicks, bots, CTR, bounce rate, session duration. Defaults to the full retained history.

tools.name: get_timeseries
tools.description: Daily traffic series for a site (visits, visitors, pageviews, clicks, bots per day, in the site's timezone).

tools.name: get_breakdown
tools.description: Top-N breakdown of a site's traffic by one dimension.

tools.name: get_bot_report
tools.description: Bot traffic on a site - DevDome separates every hit into human vs bot. kind 'bots' = known-bot catalog activity; 'threats' = suspicious/behavioral detections.

tools.name: get_realtime
tools.description: Visitors active on the site in the last 5 minutes, with their current page and path.

tools.name: get_visitors
tools.description: Recent individual visits: entry page, path taken, country, device, human/bot.

tools.name: get_site_health
tools.description: Uptime/health summary for a site: status, response time, TLS/domain checks, open incidents.
